notes: §1985:VII.2.12.3 SR3: "When either the integer-1 RECORDS phrase or the integer-2 CLOCK-UNITS phrase is specified, implementor-name-1 must be given in the RERUN clause." The clause is 1985-only: rerunClause parses it at every edition, VisitRerunClause refuses it from 2002 (COBOL0902), and at --std 85 BindIoControl collects the paragraph's RERUN clauses and ScreenRerunClauses asks the five syntax rules; the clause is otherwise a null rerun facility. On the RECORDS and CLOCK-UNITS arms ScreenRerunClauses reports COBOL6530 when the clause has no ON phrase and also when the ON word names a file, since that operand is then file-name-1 and not implementor-name-1 (§1985:VII.2.12.4 GR2 d: "the device specified by implementor-name-1, which must be specified in the ON phrase"). Probed at --std 85 beyond the witness (RECORDS with no ON phrase): CLOCK-UNITS with no ON phrase, and RECORDS and CLOCK-UNITS with a sequential file in ON, are refused; both phrases with an implementor-name in ON are accepted, and the END OF REEL phrase without ON stays legal.

next.reason: 1985: "When either the integer-1 RECORDS phrase or the integer-2 CLOCK-UNITS phrase is specified, implementor-name-1 must be given"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the RERUN clause; no candidate covers RERUN, RECORDS or CLOCK-UNITS checkpoint phrases". No 2023 clause carries the RERUN feature, and the wording candidates cover only unrelated integer rules (PAGE, BLOCK, OCCURS etc.), so the feature is absent in 2023.
